description: Search the signed-in company's matched tenders by words — the search box of the tender list in Przetargowy Janusz: only tenders that fit the company profile (CPV codes, voivodeships). view 'recommended' (filtered by what the company does, when its profile says so) or 'all'; 50 per page, the same tender cards as list_matched_tenders. To search all Polish tenders, use search_tenders. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

query.description: Words in Polish — the tenders are in Polish, e.g. 'oprogramowanie'

name: search_my_tenders
title: Szukaj w przetargach mojej firmy
